title: Generate a Test OAuth Token Request
description: The QA test individual's details used to generate an OAuth access token.

nino.description: The test individual's National Insurance number. Used for Government Gateway sign-in and, when identifier is omitted, the MTD IT ID lookup.

identifier.description: The test individual's MTD IT ID, used as the HMRC-MTD-IT enrolment identifier MTDITID. If omitted or null, it is looked up using the NINO.
